description: Use when an agent needs to know who is trading a Solana token. Returns the unique traders over its latest swaps, top-5 share of volume, round-trip wallets, share of brand-new buyer wallets and launch-slot bundle size for mints under 7 days. Costs 0.008 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

swaps.description: swaps to read, 20-100, default 50; a 20 second budget may return fewer, flagged truncated
